svg.title: Uniqueness of entrywise limits gives the same family for every reporting level k; before e it may be defined as zero, where no conclusion is imposed. For completeness retain the scalar majorant proof, with nonnegative arrays, A ≥0, integer d ≥0, Z ≥0 and θ > 0. All constants are uniform over the schedules and terminal indices under consideration. Let ∆i = ti+1 −ti ≥log 3 and τi = 2 + Z + |ti −tk|. If fi ≤e−θ∆ifi+1 + gi, fN ≤gN and 0 ≤gi ≤Aτ d i , put K = 2(d + 1)/θ, q = e−θ log 3/2 and B = A/(1 −q).
